Melayu: syntax-esc — How-to: Escape characters, Delimiters and Quotes. English: syntax-esc on PowerShell.
```powershell
`0  Null
   `a  Alert bell/beep
   `b  Backspace
   `e  Escape (added in PowerShell 6)
   `f  Form feed (use with printer output)
   `n  New line
   `r  Carriage return
`r`n
Carriage return + New line
   `t  Horiz
```
